subject: Plotting confidence around prediction intervals in pcountOpen

messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: Plotting confidence around prediction intervals in pcountOpen
parts:
I would like to make plots of the detection for a range of each detection covariate (assuming other values equal to mean - 0 standardized) with confidence intervals around the predicted line. I'm having trouble with this for pcountOpen.

Here are the results of my model
Call:
pcountOpen(lambdaformula = ~trt, gammaformula = ~mCanopy, omegaformula = ~mCanopy,
    pformula = ~canopy + DOY + DOY2 + soilT + soilT2 + moisture +
        NCO, data = DF4c, mixture = "P", K = 100, dynamics = "autoreg",
    starts = coef(M4.11.p50), se = TRUE)

Abundance:
               Estimate    SE     z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)       3.088 0.362  8.53 1.42e-17
trtClearcut      -1.809 0.442 -4.09 4.27e-05
trtGroup         -1.763 0.518 -3.40 6.69e-04
trtPatch         -1.921 0.382 -5.03 4.97e-07
trtSingle Tree   -0.969 0.200 -4.85 1.25e-06
trtStorm         -0.418 0.118 -3.54 4.04e-04

Recruitment:
            Estimate    SE      z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)   -6.028 0.734 -8.208 2.24e-16
mCanopy        0.368 0.398  0.926 3.54e-01

Apparent Survival:
            Estimate    SE       z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept)  6.00386 0.734  8.1767 2.92e-16
mCanopy     -0.00821 0.420 -0.0196 9.84e-01

Detection:
            Estimate     SE       z  P(>|z|)
(Intercept) -3.06728 0.3677 -8.3422 7.29e-17
canopy      -0.00198 0.0827 -0.0239 9.81e-01
DOY         -2.85861 0.7038 -4.0617 4.87e-05
DOY2         2.91700 0.7156  4.0766 4.57e-05
soilT        1.65217 0.3361  4.9153 8.87e-07
soilT2      -1.81178 0.3633 -4.9873 6.12e-07
moisture     0.11507 0.0486  2.3663 1.80e-02
NCO          0.14179 0.0448  3.1666 1.54e-03

AIC: 2495.481

Here is the attempt at generating confidence intervals
temp.x <- seq(min(SoilT4, na.rm=TRUE), max(SoilT4, na.rm=TRUE), length.out=1000)
temp.xs <- (temp.x-mean(as.matrix(SoilT4), na.rm=TRUE))/sd(as.numeric(as.matrix(SoilT4)), na.rm=TRUE)
temp2.xs <- temp.x^2
NewTemp <- data.frame(canopy = 0, DOY = 0, DOY2 = 0, soilT = temp.xs, soilT2 = temp2.xs, moisture = 0, NCO = 0, trt = factor("Reference"), mCanopy = 0)
p.temp.predict <- round(predict(ModelFit, type = "det", data = NewTemp, appendData = TRUE), 3)
I get an error with appending the data:

Error in data.frame(out, as(newdata, "data.frame")) :
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 1568, 98

98 is the number of sites and 1568 is the number of observations (4 obs in each of 4 primary periods at each of 98 sites). If I use appendData = FALSE, it works but it looks like I get 1568 predicted detections, but not over a continuous soil temperature gradient as desired. Any ideas where I'm going wrong in my new data creation? Is there a better way to get predicted estimates with confidence intervals for detection covariates. I ultimately want one plot for each of the 4 significant detection covariates, holding the others at mean levels. I tried creating the NewData with only the detection covariates but got the same error.

Thanks for any suggestions
Dan

messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: Re: Plotting confidence around prediction intervals in pcountOpen
parts:
Thanks Chris - such a simple mistake. Works great now with 'newdata' in place of 'data' in the predict function

-----
Hi Dan,

I think when using predict with gdistsamp i give it an argument called "newdata".  I see you gave it an argument called "data".  I don't know if the argument name is different depending on what type of model you are running, but maybe that's the problem?
Other than that I don't have any suggestions. Never used pcountOpen before.  Let us know what the problem turns out to be.

Cheers,
Chris

--------
